    ### Features
    
    #### Supercharged by M3 Ultra.
    
    Take on extreme workflows, from detailed visual effects and 3D animation to film scoring. The powerful Neural Engine supports AI assistance in complex tasks, and the advanced GPU architecture supports Dynamic Caching, mesh shading, and ray tracing.
    
    #### Phenomenal memory and storage.
    
    Get up to 512GB unified memory and up to 16TB storage with M3 Ultra.¹
    
    #### Powerful connections.
    
    Mac Studio with M3 Ultra features six Thunderbolt 5 ports and two USB-A ports, an HDMI port, an SDXC card slot, and a headphone jack. Supports up to eight external displays.
    
    #### Fits right on your desk.
    
    The compact 7.7-inch square Mac Studio enclosure is designed to fit perfectly under most displays.
    
    #### Runs cool and quiet.
    
    The thermal system is designed to let you fly through intensive tasks at incredible speeds while keeping Mac Studio quiet, so it never interferes with your workflow.
    
    #### If you love iPhone, You’ll love Mac.
    
    Mac works like magic with your other Apple devices. View and control what’s on your iPhone from your Mac with iPhone Mirroring.⁴ Copy something on iPhone and paste it on Mac. Send texts with Messages or use your Mac to make and answer FaceTime calls.⁵

Apple Certified Refurbished Products
------------------------------------

### (1) What are Apple Certified Refurbished Products?

Apple Certified Refurbished Products are pre-owned Apple products that undergo Apple's stringent refurbishment process prior to being offered for sale. While only some units are returned due to technical issues, every unit is evaluated to ensure it meets Apple's quality standards.

Each Apple Certified Refurbished Product:

*   undergoes full functionality testing and any defective modules identified in testing are replaced.
*   Apple Watch and Apple Pencil devices that require replacement parts are not included in the Apple Certified Refurbished Program.
*   is put through a thorough cleaning process and inspection.
*   is repackaged (including appropriate manuals, cables, new boxes).
*   includes either the Operating System originally shipped with the unit or, in some cases, a more recent version.
*   is placed into a Final QA inspection prior to being added to sellable refurbished stock.

Refurbishment procedures follow the same basic technical guidelines as Apple's Finished Goods testing procedures.

### (2) What should I expect when I purchase an Apple Certified Refurbished Product?

*   Substantial savings
*   A fully functional unit with complete documentation
*   The assurance that the unit meets Apple's premiere quality standards, and that its defective components have been replaced by genuine Apple components

  

### (3) Can I purchase the AppleCare plan for my Apple Certified Refurbished Product?

All Apple Certified Refurbished Products are covered by [a one-year limited warranty](https://www.apple.com/legal/warranty/)
. For more coverage, you have the option of getting AppleCare with your Apple Certified Refurbished Product to get one-stop support and service — from the people who know them best. Get easy, fast repairs for accidents like drops and spills. A replacement if your iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch is lost or stolen. And 24/7 priority care with just a chat, call, or tap.

### (4) A refurbished item that I wanted is no longer available. How can I ensure that I get an item when it's in stock?

Refurbished supply is usually very limited and we often run out of refurbished inventory. We recommend that you act quickly if you see an item that you like. A product will be reserved for you once you've completed checking out and we've received full authorized payment. Please note that some payment methods take longer than others and that availability of a refurbished product is not guaranteed until we receive your full payment.

Refurbished Apple Mac Studio Desktops

The Apple Mac Studio represents a revolutionary leap forward in professional desktop computing. Specifically engineered for creators, designers, developers, and data scientists, this high-octane powerhouse packs unbelievable processing muscle and extreme graphics rendering capabilities into a compact, footprint-friendly modular design. Driven exclusively by advanced Apple Silicon architectures, the Mac Studio transforms any desk into a high-end production suite.

### Mind-Boggling Processing Power & Connectivity

**Elite Apple Silicon Engineering:** Explore robust Max and Ultra tier M-series configurations engineered with massive unified memory banks to handle complex 3D rendering, multi-stream 8K video timelines, and dense code compilation effortlessly.

**Revolutionary Thermal Innovation:** Work in absolute peace. The Mac Studio utilizes a ground-up redesigned internal cooling system that moves vast amounts of air silently, ensuring optimal processing throughput even under peak workloads.

**Comprehensive Studio Connectivity:** Build your perfect modular array with extensive high-speed ports, including front-facing USB-C or Thunderbolt connections, an SDXC card reader, rear Thunderbolt pipelines, HDMI, and rapid 10Gb Ethernet capability.

### The Mac of All Trades Advantage

**Comprehensive 40-Point Diagnostics:** Operating right out of Tampa, Florida, our hardware technicians put every single Mac Studio through a rigorous internal physical check, full operating system restoration, and careful deep cleaning.

**Maximize Your Workspace Budget:** Secure elite, modern technical specifications and expansive solid-state storage spaces for a fraction of original retail costs, while actively keeping top-tier electronics out of landfills.

**Worry-Free Professional Ordering:** Every device arrives safely packaged with a verified compatible power cable. Your secure checkout includes free ground shipping across the contiguous US, flexible partner financing, a 30-day return policy, and up to 5 years of extended protection plans.

Need an immersive, all-in-one setup or a modular desktop with an even smaller footprint? Check out our vibrant [Retina iMac collections](https://www.macofalltrades.com/imac/)
